, reaching the milestone nearly six years after it was launched. Designed to deliver economic insights for real estate professionals and anyone interested in real estate and related economic issues in under 15 minutes an episode, The REconomy Podcast’s audience continues to grow, ranking among the top 10% of podcasts in average first-week downloads, according to industry statistics from Buzzsprout.

The podcast is hosted by First American Chief Economist Mark Fleming and Deputy Chief Economist Odeta Kushi, whose data-driven insights into the dynamics shaping the housing market are frequently quoted in national news and industry trade media outlets. Senior Commercial Real Estate Economist Xander Snyder and Senior Economist Sam Williamson regularly join Fleming and Kushi on the podcast as well.

“Reaching 150 episodes is a testament to our listeners’ continued interest in the forces shaping the housing market and the broader economy,” said Fleming. “Our goal remains the same as it was at episode one: sharing our housing market analysis and practical, clear-cut insights in a fun, engaging way to help home buyers, sellers, and real estate and mortgage finance professionals make more informed decisions.”

In the 150th episode, the First American economics team examines how the real estate market has evolved since the inception of the podcast, highlighting key trends that have shaped the market dynamics present today. Launched in October 2020, the biweekly REconomy Podcast can be found on all major podcasting platforms. Other recent episodes include:
